create_registry: create a new Registry instance with a given name for storing named objects
register_object_as_decorator: register a class or function in the registry using the register decorator pattern
register_object_as_call: register an object directly in the registry by calling register with the object as argument
get_registered_object: get a registered object from the registry by its name and raise KeyError if not found
check_registry_contains: check if a named object exists in the registry using the contains operator
